fields.schemeName: Food Processing and Value Addition Management
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote the establishment of food processing units in Uttarakhand, enhance value addition in agricultural and horticultural products, support entrepreneurs with financial assistance, and strengthen the state’s food processing ecosystem.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Campaign, Seminar and Sports under Disability Sector
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to extend financial support for National & International Events organized by reputed organizations or an individual person with disabilities working for welfare of Persons with Disabilities.

fields.schemeName: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Swawlamban Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage unemployed youth to gain access to low-cost capital for setting up an entrepreneurship. Through this scheme, a 40% front-ended capital investment subsidy is provided to the selected entrepreneurs.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Assistance to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME): Assistance for Interest Subsidy (Manufacturing Sector)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Scheme for Assistance to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)" launched by the Industries and Mines Department aims to position Gujarat as a global business hub, promoting sustainable manufacturing, MSME growth, and export competitiveness.

fields.schemeName: Jhota Buggi/Camel/Mule Cart Scheme (HSFDC)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, the Corporation provides loans to individuals from Below Poverty Line (BPL) families, whose annual family income does not exceed ₹1,80,000/-, in both rural and urban areas for purchasing animal-driven carts such as Jhota Buggis, camel carts, and mule carts.

fields.schemeName: Piggery Farming Scheme (HSFDC)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, the Corporation provides loans/benefits to individuals from Below Poverty Line (BPL) families, whose annual family income does not exceed ₹1,80,000/-, in both rural and urban areas for self-employment income-generating activities such as piggery farming.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
fields.schemeName: Agricultural Marketing Infrastructure
fields.briefDescription: The revitalized and farmers’ income enhancing centric sub-scheme Agricultural Marketing Infrastructure (AMI) of Integrated Scheme for Agricultural Marketing (ISAM) is meant for holistic development of agricultural value chain critically focusing each linkage of post-harvest value chain.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
fields.schemeName: Raw Material Assistance Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Raw Material Assistance Scheme aims to help MSMEs by way of financing the purchase of Raw Material (Both indigenous & imported). This gives an opportunity to MSMEs to focus better on manufacturing quality products.

fields.schemeName: Sardar Patel National Unity Award
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, the highest civilian recognition in the field of national unity is provided to individuals or institutions demonstrating exceptional dedication to strengthening the unity of India.

fields.schemeName: Ayush Oushadhi Gunvatta evam Uttpadan Samvardhan Yojana (AOGUSY): Support for Development of Standards and Accreditation/Certification of Ayush Products and Materials in Collaboration With BIS, QCI and Other Relevant Scientific Institutions and Industrial R&D Centres
fields.briefDescription: The scheme-component aims to support organizations and institutions in developing standards and accreditation frameworks for Ayush products and materials to ensure quality, safety, and scientific validation.

fields.schemeName: Ayush Oushadhi Gunvatta evam Uttpadan Samvardhan Yojana (AOGUSY): Strengthening and Up-Gradation of Ayush Pharmacies and Drug Testing Laboratories to Achieve Higher Standards
fields.briefDescription: The scheme-component aims to strengthen and upgrade ASU&H pharmacies and drug testing laboratories to improve quality control and manufacturing standards of Ayush drugs.

fields.schemeName: Jute Raw Material Bank Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Jute Raw Material Bank Scheme (JRMB) will be set up in the local clusters across the country in collaboration with bonafide Agencies who have adequate experience in similar activities and have the required storage, display, and selling infrastructure.

fields.schemeName: Mizoram Grant-in-Aid to Voluntary Organisations and Individuals
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to voluntary organizations and individuals to support welfare activities for disadvantaged and marginalized groups such as women, children, disabled persons, elderly, and socially vulnerable individuals.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
fields.schemeName: Coir Vikas Yojana- Coir Industry Technology Upgradation Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Coir Industry Technology Upgradation Scheme (CITUS)” is a component of “Coir Vikas Yojana” and the scheme was launched by Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, Government of India.

fields.schemeName: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) For Promoting Telecom & Networking Products Manufacturing In India
fields.briefDescription: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme aims to boost domestic manufacturing, investments and export in the telecom and networking products The PLI Scheme will be implemented within the overall financial limits of ₹ 12,195 Crores only (Rupees Twelve Thousand One Hundred and Ninety-Five Crore only)

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
fields.schemeName: Modified Market Development Assistance Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance the production and sales of Khadi and Polyvastra products by supporting technology upgradation, market promotion, and providing direct incentives to artisans and Karyakartas. It targets Khadi Institutions and their associated artisans and workers.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
fields.schemeName: International Cooperation Scheme: Market Development Assistance
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “International Cooperation Scheme” was launched by the MSME, Govt. of India with the aim to capacity build MSMEs for entering the export market by facilitating their participation in international exhibitions/fairs/conferences/seminars/buyer-seller meets abroad.

fields.schemeName: AICTE-Training programs for Physical Education Trainers/Sport-Games Teachers/Director of Sports
fields.briefDescription: Training programs for Physical Education Trainers/Sport-Games Teachers/Director of Sports, aims to support institution in conducting trainings to develop the skill of the participants to involve the masses in traditional sports/games and fun games for physical activity through recreation.

fields.schemeName: National Startup Awards
fields.briefDescription: The National Startup Awards by Startup India aims to recognize and reward outstanding startups and ecosystem enablers building innovative products or solutions and scalable enterprises.

fields.schemeName: Jute Resource-Cum-Production Centre
fields.briefDescription: Jute Resource-Cum-Production Centre (JRCPC) will be set up in the local clusters and localities across the country in collaboration with bonafide Agencies who have adequate experience in training and skilling programs and have required training cum-production infrastructure.

fields.schemeName: AICTE Grant for Organizing Conference
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance to institutions for organizing conferences in various fields of science and technology, management, and hotel management, including BBA, BCA and BMS institutions.

fields.schemeName: Export Promotion Capital Goods Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the EPCG Scheme is to facilitate import of capital goods for producing quality goods and services and enhance India’s manufacturing competitiveness. EPCG scheme allows import of capital goods for pre-production, production and post-production at zero customs duty.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Loan Based Schemes For Safai Karamchari - Sanitary Marts Scheme
fields.briefDescription: A sanitary mart is a one-stop-shop for all things for sanitation and hygiene. It is a shopping place where the sanitary needs of the common man could be met. It serves both as a shop and as a service centre.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
fields.schemeName: National Livestock Mission: Genetic Improvement of Pig breeds - Establishment of Pig Semen Collection and Processing Lab
fields.briefDescription: The Scheme aims to enhance per-animal productivity, reduce inbreeding, and minimize sexually transmitted diseases in pigs. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided for establishing semen processing labs at government pig farms.

fields.schemeName: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Research & Development Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "NHDP: Research & Development Scheme" is introduced to generate feedback on economic, social, aesthetic, and promotional aspects of various crafts and artisans in the handicraft sector. The surveys and studies are sponsored/conducted to generate suitable inputs for planning purposes.

fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram
fields.briefDescription: The Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram (PMJVK) is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme, being implemented with the objective to develop infrastructure projects such as community assets , in the identified areas with development deficits for socio-economic development of the said areas.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
fields.schemeName: IVRI Institute Scholarship For M.V.Sc. And Ph.D.
fields.briefDescription: The Indian Veterinary Research Institute will award scholarships to MVSc and PhD students who need financial assistance.his provision will be utilized to assist as many students as possible who have good academic record and who are making diligent efforts to pursue higher education.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance For Allied Cultural Activities
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provide financial assistance for creating infrastructure and assets that enhance audio-visual experiences for cultural activities, enabling regular live performances and festivals at locations that attract large numbers of tourists and visitors.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
fields.schemeName: Mission on Integrated Development of Horticulture- NHM and HMNEH
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote the holistic growth of the horticulture sector through production enhancement, productivity improvement, post-harvest management, processing, marketing support, skill development, and infrastructure creation for horticulture crops while augmenting farmers’ income.

fields.schemeName: Scheme of Human Resources Development in Sports: Publication of Outstanding Works on Sports Related Subjects
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the publication of outstanding works, journals, e-publications, online content, and web-based applications related to sports and games, thereby promoting sports knowledge, research, and awareness among stakeholders and the general public.

fields.schemeName: Fund of Funds for Startups
fields.briefDescription: Launched in January 2016 under Startup India, the Fund of Funds for Startups is managed by SIDBI. It supports DPIIT-recognized startups indirectly by investing in SEBI-registered AIFs, which must invest at least twice the FFS contribution.

fields.schemeName: Khelo India Scheme: Fit India Movement
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote physical fitness among all citizens by encouraging regular physical activity, conducting fitness assessments, certifying schools, and organizing fitness campaigns and events.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of New and Renewable Energy
fields.schemeName: Phase-II Of The Grid Connected Rooftop Solar Programme
fields.briefDescription: Phase-II of the Grid Connected Rooftop Solar Programme, this programme is introduced by Ministry of New & Renewable Energy(MNRE), GoI with JAKEDA as a nodal agency in the UT of J&K  for achieving cumulative capacity  of 220MW under 20MW  Residential Scheme and 200 MW Jammu Solar City “Solar City.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Scheme Of Assistance To Disabled Persons For Purchase/Fitting Of Aids/Appliances
fields.briefDescription: The main objective of the Scheme is to assist needy disabled persons in procuring durable, sophisticated, scientifically manufactured, modern, standard aids and appliances that can promote their physical, social and psychological rehabilitation by reducing the effect of disabilities.

fields.schemeName: Scheme For Assistance For Start Ups/ Innovation
fields.briefDescription: The "Scheme for Assistance for Startups / Innovation" has been introduced to encourage R&D and start innovation and entrepreneurship at different levels of the startup cycle. The scheme came into force on 07/08/2020 and will remain in operation for a period of 5 years, i.e. upto 06.08.2025.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Samuhik Vivah Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, wedding programs are conducted according to the rituals being practiced in various communities and religions. Another objective of the scheme is to abolish the unwanted and extravagance in wedding ceremonies

fields.schemeName: Chief Minister's Micro Finance Initiative
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote access to credit for economic activities undertaken by individual farmers, entrepreneurs, Self-Help Groups (SHGs), and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) in the state of Nagaland.

fields.schemeName: Scheme For Waiver Of Loans To Handloom And Powerloom Sector
fields.briefDescription: "Scheme for Waiver of Loans to Handloom and Powerloom Sector" redeems the debt accrued by the farmers, Self-Help Groups, Weavers, etc., to the Scheduled Commercial Banks/Cooperative Banks, Urban Cooperative Banks, and RRBs, through their Branches/Institutions in the State of Andhra Pradesh.

fields.schemeName: Promotion And Development Of Tea Tourism Infrastructure In Assam
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Promotion and Development of Tea Tourism Infrastructure in Assam” was launched by the Government of Assam which broadly includes the overall experience of tourists in the midst of a tea garden or state, with accommodation facilities in iconic bungalows with modern amenities.

fields.schemeName: Chief Minister Floriculture Mission
fields.briefDescription: This is a special scheme initiated during 2014-15 aimed at all-round development of floriculture sector in the State which incorporates cultivation, marketing, training etc. For the year 2015- 16 cultivation of Gerbera under Shade net house with tissue cultured planting materials is proposed.

fields.schemeName: Production Linked Incentive Scheme For Automobile And Auto Component Industry
fields.briefDescription: The government of India has launched the scheme “Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Automobile and Auto Components Industry” in India to enhance India’s Manufacturing Capabilities for Advanced Automotive Products.

fields.schemeName: Goa Village & Municipal Child Committee Grants And Awards Scheme
fields.briefDescription: GVMCCGS awards the Panchayats / Municipal Local Bodies to discuss and resolve the issues relating to children. The winner is awarded an annual financial grant of ₹ 10,000/- towards administrative expenses incurred on organizing the activities of the Committee.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Providing (Golden Jubilee) One Time Grant-In-Aid in Memory of Blessed Mother Tereza
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to protect and support the thousands of children living in slums and on the streets of Goa, also orphans and runaways escaping poverty, neglect or abuse. These children are often at great risk from malnutrition, illness and neglect, and need a helping hand in healthcare, shelter etc.

fields.schemeName: Goa State Cultural Award for Institution
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Goa State Cultural Award for Institution" by the Directorate of Art and Culture, Government of Goa is designed to recognize, promote and appreciate the contribution of the institution in the field of Art and culture. This will give a tremendous boost to cultural institutions in Goa.

fields.schemeName: Grant for Incubation Centers within Educational Institutes Scheme
fields.briefDescription: “Grant for Incubation Centers within Educational Institutes Scheme” is for the educational institutes in Goa, affiliated with a recognized public university. They can avail of a one-time grant towards capital expenses for setting up an incubator within their institute campuses.

fields.schemeName: Assistance Scheme for Handicraft Artisans
fields.briefDescription: The Scheme intends to provide financial assistance in the form of grant to the artisans in the handicrafts sector for setting up handicraft enterprises. The assistance is a one time support to eligible artisans of the state as back end assistance.

fields.schemeName: Scheme of Grant-in-Aid to Voluntary Organisations Working for the Welfare of Scheduled Tribes
fields.briefDescription: The Central Sector Scheme “Scheme of Grant-in-Aid to Voluntary Organisations Working for the Welfare of Scheduled Tribes” was launched by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
fields.schemeName: Integrated Scheme on Agriculture Cooperation
fields.briefDescription: The Integrated Scheme on Agriculture Cooperation (ISAC) is a Central Sector Scheme of the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India. It is being implemented through the National Cooperative Development Corporation (NCDC).

fields.schemeName: Performance Linked Grant Scheme for Smaller Business Units
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the "Performance Linked Grant Scheme for Smaller Business Units" is to provide a Performance Linked Grant of 5% of the reported net income to the eligible Information Technology Units in the State of Goa, subject to a total cap of ₹ 25,00,000.

fields.schemeName: Market Support Scheme for Smaller Business Units
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the "Market Support Scheme for Smaller Business Units" is to provide Market Support to the eligible IT Units in Goa. A reimbursement of 50% of the exhibition rental cost will be provided for participating in national/ international exhibitions, limited to 9 square meter of space.
